Use Venn on your computer

Source: R/deciders.R
decider_venn.Rd

Makes a decider for a local Venn server (venn-vdm, a research preview by Mark Russinovich, https://markrussinovich.github.io/venn-vdm/). Venn answers noul, choice and score questions about a text, or about one image, with a small decision head on the reader EmbeddingGemma 2. It needs no key and makes no paid call.

Usage

decider_venn(
  model = "venn-1",
  base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8000",
  input = NULL
)

Arguments

model

The model name: "venn-1" (the default).

base_url

The server root. The requests go to <base_url>/api/alpha/decisions.

input

The input type that the model reads: "text", "image" or "text+image". NULL (the default) takes it from the internal table of input types; a model that is not in the table is not checked. decide() stops before any request when an input does not fit.

Value

A decider object for decide().

Details

Venn needs Python 3.12. Install and start it from a clone of https://github.com/markrussinovich/venn-vdm:

python -m pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
python -m pip install ".[embedding]"
venn download-embedder
venn serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

The server is ready when http://127.0.0.1:8000/health shows "reader":"ready".

Venn is a research preview with an alpha endpoint. Its server answers one request at a time, on the CPU, so max_active of decide() gives no speed-up. With images on a slow CPU, a request that waits in the queue of the server can pass the limit of 300 seconds of each request and get a row error: then use max_active = 1.

For a noul question, describe both answers (true and false of question_noul()): an answer with no description reaches Venn as its bare name, for example "false". Its probabilities are not calibrated: give the setup a calibrator (see decision_setup()). It reports no tokens and no cost, so .input_tokens and .cost are NA.

Images are experimental in Venn: decide() sends one image in each request with the header X-Venn-Experimental: media. Without reference images, Venn was at chance on the textiles data (AUC 0.48). decide() stops before any request for an input with a text and an image (Venn would ignore the text) and for reference images (not supported).

See also

Other deciders: decider_foundry(), decider_gemini(), decider_openai(), decider_openrouter(), decider_systemone(), decider_typesafe()

Examples

decider_venn()
#> <decider> Venn
#> * Model: venn-1
#> * URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/alpha/decisions
#> * Request format: venn
#> * Input: text+image
